pipeline.modality: EDO peptide-conjugated phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligomer (PPMO); splice modulator
pipeline.license_origin: Internally developed (EDO platform from MRC Cambridge / University of Oxford founders).

indications.trial_design: Phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled multiple-ascending dose; open-label extension follow-on
key_milestones: FREEDOM Phase 1 (NCT06204809) completed Oct 2025 with robust splicing correction at 5/10/15 mg/kg
FREEDOM2 readouts from 5 and 10 mg/kg cohorts expected in 2026

excluded_legacy_terminated.reason: CONNECT1-EDO51 Phase 2 terminated; CONNECT2 placebo-controlled study withdrawn. Program de-prioritized; company devoting majority of resources to PGN-EDODM1 per 2025 10-K
